name: DC Cafe POS
description: Standalone point-of-sale, inventory, and sales management system for DC Cafe. Module-owned auth, products, orders, ingredients, and customer loyalty.
author: Ikabud Platform Team

exposes.description: List DC Cafe products with category and pricing
List DC Cafe product stock levels for inventory tab
Get single DC Cafe product by ID
List DC Cafe orders with status and totals
Get single DC Cafe order with items
Get single DC Cafe customer with order history
List DC Cafe inventory stock levels
Module-owned authentication for DC Cafe users

settings_fields.label: Low-stock alerts
settings_fields.description: Show the low-stock tile and list on the dashboard. Turning this off hides the alert everywhere.

settings_fields.label: Include finished products in alerts
settings_fields.description: Alerts cover doughnuts and meals as well as ingredients. Without this only ingredients are counted.

settings_fields.label: Alert only from verified counts
settings_fields.description: Base the alert on the last recorded physical count (Ending) instead of the running balance, which drifts when receiving is entered late.

settings_fields.label: Email a low-stock digest
settings_fields.description: Send the low-stock list by email. At most one digest is sent per day.

settings_fields.label: Low-stock digest recipients
settings_fields.description: Comma-separated addresses. Defaults to the branch supervisor when left blank.

settings_fields.label: Selling below zero stock
settings_fields.description: Warn (default) lets the cashier sell what is physically on the rack even when receiving has not been entered yet, and records a shortfall for follow-up. Strict blocks the sale. Allow negative permits a negative balance without flagging it.

options.label: Warn — sell it and flag the shortfall

settings_fields.label: Default product view
settings_fields.description: How the product menu opens for a cashier who has not chosen a view.

settings_fields.label: Hide out-of-stock items at the till
settings_fields.description: Removes items showing OUT from the product menu so a cashier cannot tap them by mistake.

settings_fields.label: Allow stock top-up from the till
settings_fields.description: Shows an Add stock button when a cashier taps an item showing OUT, so a delivery that has not been entered yet can be recorded as the day goes on.

settings_fields.label: Allow discounts at the till
settings_fields.description: Turning this off hides the discount controls from the cashier.

settings_fields.label: Maximum discount a cashier may give (%)
settings_fields.description: Caps the discount on a single sale, whatever the reason, including a voucher. 0 blocks discounts entirely; 100 leaves only the subtotal as the limit. Set above your largest statutory rate if you run bigger promos.

settings_fields.label: Allow voiding a sale
settings_fields.description: On by default. A supervisor still approves each void with their PIN. Turn this off to make completed sales final — the void control disappears from the till and the server refuses the request.

settings_fields.label: Require a GCash reference number
settings_fields.description: Off by default — the reference stays optional. Turn on if the branch must record it before completing a GCash sale.

settings_fields.label: Allow parking an order (order queue)
settings_fields.description: Off by default. Turn on to let the cashier park the current sale as Pending so the next customer can be served, then bring it back and take payment. A parked order holds no stock and is not counted as a sale until it is finalized.

settings_fields.label: Require a supervisor to discard a parked order
settings_fields.description: Off by default — any cashier can drop a parked order, since it is their own held sale and nothing was sold. Turn on to require an administrator or supervisor; the discard control disappears from the till and the server refuses the request.

settings_fields.label: Allow a viewer to see the dashboard and reports
settings_fields.description: Off by default. Turn on to let a user with the Viewer role sign in and read the analytics dashboard and reports — sales overall and per branch, best sellers, Pareto split and the weekly/monthly projection. A viewer cannot reach the till, orders, inventory or settings.

settings_fields.label: Auto-open the receipt after payment
settings_fields.description: Opens the print dialog automatically once a sale completes.

settings_fields.label: Receipt footer
settings_fields.description: Printed under the receipt, for example a thank-you line or contact details.

settings_fields.label: Enable the production view
settings_fields.description: Gives kitchen staff a dedicated ingredients view without exposing sales or cash figures.

settings_fields.label: Enable commissary roll-up
settings_fields.description: Shows the supplying kitchen combined shortfall across its assigned branches.
